vPFU
```{r}
calc.titer <- function(Plaques, Dilution, Plating) {
  # Ensure plaques and dilution are the same length
  if (length(Plaques) != length(Dilution)) {
    stop("Plaques and Dilution vectors must have the same length")
  }
  
  # Compute titer
  titer <- (Plaques / (10^(-Dilution) * Plating)) * 1000
  
  return(titer)
}

#Change acc to results
#delta6.SPO1
Plaques <- c(492,51,4)
Dilution <- c(3,4,5)
Plating <- 100

del6.SPO1<- calc.titer(Plaques, Dilution, Plating)

del6.SPO1<- mean(del6.SPO1)

#sigG.spo1.virospores
Plaques <-c(1)
Dilution<-c(0)
Plating<-c(100)

sigG.SPO1<-calc.titer(Plaques, Dilution, Plating)

sigG.SPO1<-mean(sigG.SPO1)



```
sCFU
```{r}
calc.titer <- function(Plaques, Dilution, Plating) {
  # Ensure plaques and dilution are the same length
  if (length(Plaques) != length(Dilution)) {
    stop("Plaques and Dilution vectors must have the same length")
  }
  
  # Compute titer
  titer <- (Plaques / (10^(-Dilution) * Plating)) * 1000
  
  return(titer)
}

#Change acc to results
#delta6.SPO1.CFU
Plaques <- c(34,2)
Dilution <- c(3,4)
Plating <- 100


del6.SPO1.CFU<- calc.titer(Plaques, Dilution, Plating)

del6.SPO1<- mean(del6.SPO1.CFU)

```
Graphing

```{r}
SPOIIE.SPO1<- 0
sigF.SPO1<- 0

del6.sd<-sd(del6.SPO1)
SPOIIE.sd<-0
sigF.sd<-0
sigG.sd<-sd(sigG.SPO1)


df <- data.frame(
  Strain = c("del6.SPO1", "SPOIIE.SPO1", "sigF.SPO1", "sigG.SPO1"),
  Titer = c(del6.SPO1, SPOIIE.SPO1, sigF.SPO1, sigG.SPO1)
)


vPFU<-ggplot(df, aes(x = Strain, y = Titer)) +
  geom_col() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +  # Adjust colors prn
scale_y_log10()+
    labs(title = "Virospore formation in sporulation gene knockout mutants",
       x = "Strain",
       y = "Virospore Titer (vPFU/mL)") +
  theme_minimal() 
  



ggsave("20250711_Virospores.png", plot=vPFU, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
vPFU
```
